description: Discover the best hotels in Uluwatu, Indonesia. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Elevated Alila Uluwatu Private Pool Villas with Cliffside Cabana Bar & World-Class Spa
hotels.description: An unbeatable clifftop location and endless horizon panoramas await at this five-star escape, home to a refined collection of private pool villas offering sophisticated interiors and peaceful seclusion. Make your way to Spa Alila for a transcendent experience using ancient Asian healing techniques, or gaze out over the ocean from The Warung, the onsite restaurant inspired by traditional food stalls. When you're ready to descend from the heavenly clifftops and sink your toes into golden shores, the beach is accessible via an impressive exclusive stairway which hugs the cliffside.

hotels.title: Uluwatu Clifftop Opulence with Daily Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner & Cocktails
hotels.description: Embrace blissful seclusion perched on a clifftop overlooking the magnificent Indian Ocean with a stay at this ultra-stylish, palm-dotted resort, perfectly positioned in Bali’s vibrant southernmost tip: Uluwatu. Located just moments from plunging cliff faces, a spellbinding coastline and spectacular sunsets - and boasting privileged views of the shimmering Bingin and Padang Padang beaches - it’s truly a surfer’s paradise. Perfect for honeymooners and couples, this resort offers relaxed island opulence. It's here that you can relax by the spectacular pool, indulge in traditional Indonesian and international delights at Artichoke or slick Western fare at the semi-alfresco Choka pool bar, or take a breather and unwind with a massage at Spa ESC. Spend your days here discovering the island's exquisite coral reefs, golden beaches and volcanic mountains before returning to this five-star oasis.

hotels.title: Uluwatu Boutique Suites & Villas with Onsite Dining, Yoga Studio & Spa
hotels.description: Discover your private slice of paradise at this seaside sanctuary in Uluwatu, where boutique suites and villas sit peacefully on the Island of the Gods. Raw timber, concrete and stone finishes create a cocoon of calm, carried by the ocean breeze and elevated by stylish facilities - including a cliffside spa, refined restaurant and shimmering infinity pool. Savour precision-crafted Japanese cuisine at Tsune Uluwatu, where every dish is a minimalist masterpiece served against a scenic ocean backdrop. At Svaha Spa Bingin, tension dissolves with every tailored treatment as you soak up the rhythm of the sea from a distance. Perfect for couples, this Balinese jewel provides the ideal launch pad for exploring secret coves by day and glowing skies by dusk.

hotels.title: Uluwatu Suite Escape with Spectacular Cliffside Pool
hotels.description: Venture to the edge of the world, where every view is of the ocean and secluded luxury is a given: this is Six Senses Uluwatu - a cliffside sanctuary perched on the southernmost tip of Bali, ranked among the top five hotels in Uluwatu on Tripadvisor. Here, a spectacular pool clings to the cliff's edge over three terraced levels, and watching the sun dip towards the glittering ocean is best enjoyed while sipping cocktails. Bali’s only World Green Council-certified resort, Six Senses Uluwatu proudly focuses on recycling, composting and reusing, using sustainable architecture with contemporary Balinese touches. Relax at the blissful spa, rejuvenate your body and soul at the yoga and meditation pavilion, and indulge in farm-to-table sustainable dining at the resort’s two restaurants.
